pages.task: Subject: "Healing Rain", a druid's healing rain falling on ONE grid cell (centred, about 85% of cell width and height). Water + healing: pale green-blue (#a8e8dc/#7fd6e8) rain streaks and round droplets with white highlights, plus soft gold-green healing sparkles (#d8f59a) and a few tiny oak leaves. No cloud object, no sky; just falling rain in the cell column. Frame 1: first few droplets and streaks high in the cell, faint soft glow low. Frames 2-4: rain thickens, streaks fall through the whole cell height, splashes with small crown shapes appear at the bottom, gold-green glow blooms at the bottom centre. Frames 5-6: peak: dense rain, wide soft glow pool at ground level with ripple rings, sparkles rising. Frames 7-8: rain thins, ripple rings and sparkles fade, last frame faint droplets and glow remnant. The middle stays fairly see-through so a creature behind remains readable.
pages.checkRules:
- Exactly 2:1, 4 columns x 2 rows, 8 equal cells; NO grid lines/borders/numbers/text.
- Background really transparent (no black, no magenta residue, no dark halo, no black rectangle); corners and cell borders transparent.
- Every frame fully inside its cell with transparent margin; no content crossing cell borders; no empty frame.
- Frames form one smooth animation: same centre/size logic between neighbours, no sudden jump, frame 1 visible, frame 8 fading remnant.
- One bold readable subject per frame, hand-painted medieval style, no neon/sci-fi/purple/noise, no characters, no text.
- Reads as WATER (pale green-blue streaks/droplets) with a soft gold-green healing glow; not fire, not blood, not poison.
- Rain falls downward, builds, peaks, fades; splash/ripple at the bottom; centre stays see-through.

pages.task: Subject: "Healing Rain ground", a SEAMLESS LOOP of a shallow pool of rain water lying on the ground, seen at a slight top-down perspective as a wide soft ellipse filling about 90% of the cell width and 60% of the cell height, centred, sitting in the lower-middle of the cell. Pale green-blue translucent water (#7fd6e8 body, #a8e8dc rim, white glints), a few slowly widening ripple rings, tiny falling droplets that make small rings, and a few drifting soft gold-green sparkles (#d8f59a). The 8 frames loop: frame 8 flows straight into frame 1 (ripples move on, sparkles drift), the ellipse outline itself stays identical in all frames. Soft translucent edge, no hard outline, no black.
